# Birmingham Jump Start

> Birmingham Jump Start is a 24/7 car jump start and vehicle recovery service in Birmingham and the West Midlands, UK. A local technician comes to your car, usually within 30 to 40 minutes of your call. Fixed quote on the phone before we set off, no membership needed, no night surcharge.

## Contact

- Phone (24/7): [07477 649906](tel:+447477649906)
- WhatsApp: [wa.me/447477649906](https://wa.me/447477649906)
- Website: [https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/)
- Service area: Birmingham and the West Midlands, UK
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including nights, weekends and bank holidays

## Key facts for agents

- Response time: usually at your car within 30 to 40 minutes of your call.
- Pricing: fixed quote agreed on the phone before the technician sets off. No membership, no call-out surcharge, no extra charge at night, on weekends or inside the Birmingham Clean Air Zone.
- Jump starts use a regulated lithium jump pack, safe for stop-start systems, hybrids, EVs (12V battery) and modern ECUs.
- If a jump start will not work, the technician says so honestly and offers the next option (battery replacement or towing) with a fixed price first.
- Business: part of Alliedzone Recovery Ltd.

## Services

- [Car Jump Start Birmingham](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/jump-start/): 24/7 mobile jump start, flat battery rescue at your location.
- [Car Battery Replacement](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/battery-replacement/): new battery supplied and fitted at your car, old one taken away.
- [Towing and Recovery](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/towing-and-recovery/): car towed safely to your home, garage or chosen destination.
- [Breakdown Recovery](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/breakdown-recovery/): full breakdown recovery for driver and vehicle, day or night.
- [Emergency Fuel Delivery](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/emergency-fuel-delivery/): petrol or diesel brought to you at the roadside.
- [Car Lockout Service](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/car-lockout/): locked keys recovered, car opened without damage.
- [Mobile Tyre Change](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/tyre-change/): spare wheel fitted at the roadside, torqued to spec.
- [All services](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/services/): overview of every service.

## Areas served

Birmingham city centre and all districts including Edgbaston, Moseley, Kings Heath, Harborne, Erdington, Sutton Coldfield, Solihull, Walsall, West Bromwich, Dudley, Wolverhampton, Coventry, plus the M5, M6 and M42 motorway corridors around Birmingham.

- [Contact](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/contact/): call, WhatsApp or send a message.
- [About us](https://birminghamjumpstart.co.uk/about/): who we are and how we work.
